title: In _mupdf_get_hdr of wprint_mupdf.c, there is a possible out-of-bounds read due to an integer overflow. (CVE-2026-58971)
description: A vulnerability exists in the _mupdf_get_hdr function of wprint_mupdf.c due to an integer overflow that may cause an out-of-bounds read. This flaw can lead to local information disclosure without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
